title: Turntable Deck (Nightclub and DJ Booth)
summary: A direct drive turntable: a 450 mm plinth with a cast aluminium platter on a magenta slipmat, the spindle, a counterweighted S arm with its headshell and cartridge, and the pitch fader plate beside it.
description: A direct drive turntable: a 450 mm plinth with a cast aluminium platter on a magenta slipmat, the spindle, a counterweighted S arm with its headshell and cartridge, and the pitch fader plate beside it. The platter is a named node that spins; the arm is fixed, because an arm tracking a groove is a linkage, not one rigid transform. No record is modelled on the mat. Metre units, +Y up, the dance floor side toward +Z, resting on y=0. Named pivoted nodes: platter, platter/mat. Rigid node-transform clips: spin. No skinning. No collision or navigation data.
